training_origin.observed_training_pattern: 18/21 opportunity clades had positive permutation-centered within-coarse hidden-memory effects; median +0.0270 AUC

opportunity_gate: fine_state_count > coarse_state_count on the frozen common frame
pair_universe: unordered retained-tip pairs sharing the same frozen coarse state
binary_outcome: pair shares the same frozen fine state
null: permute fine-state labels within each coarse-state group while preserving fine-state counts
null_centering: compare observed conditional AUC to the mean within-coarse permutation AUC; do not assume null AUC equals 0.5
pass_rule: observed conditional AUC > permutation mean and one-sided permutation p <= 0.05
fail_rule: compression opportunity exists but the pass rule is not met
sequential_gate: recover and freeze authoritative Ruellia tree/crosswalk without opening HPLC outcomes
open HPLC rows only under the existing preregistration and construct the frozen common frame
record fine/intermediate/coarse state counts and determine opportunity
if no opportunity, stop at STRUCTURAL_NO_HIDDEN_MEMORY_TEST
if opportunity exists, compute within-coarse conditional AUC and the pre-frozen 9999 within-coarse fine-label permutations
evaluate the hidden-memory pass rule independently of the earlier global fine-minus-coarse prediction
no_post_hoc_rescue: no change to HPLC presence threshold
no merging/splitting fine states after outcome opening
no relaxation of the rare fine-state support threshold
no change to common retained-tip frame
no substitute visible hue or continuous concentration phenotype
no switch to intermediate-vs-coarse or another contrast after seeing outcomes
claim_if_pass: A held-out biochemical radiation retains phylogenetic organization of fine compound states inside a coarse anthocyanidin-presence state beyond a within-coarse label-permutation null.
claim_if_fail: The retrospective cross-radiation hidden fine-memory pattern does not prospectively generalize to the held-out Ruellia biochemical system under the frozen conditional estimator.
claim_ceiling: one Ruellia PASS does not establish universal hierarchical memory
PASS concerns fine organization conditional on coarse membership, not a universal fine winner
source/tree/common-frame HOLD is not a biological negative
no-opportunity is a structural non-test, not a success or failure
